entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Kristín Aðalbjörg Árnadóttir is an Icelandic diplomat. She is currently Permanent representative to UN organisations in Vienna as well as ambassador to Slovakia. She was ambassador of gender equality in the Ministry for Foreign Affairs in Reykjavík 2018–2021. Previously, she has served as ambassador to Finland (2013-2017), and ambassador to China and several other countries in Asia.
